newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot prods inch higher on ACCESS after APIs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot prods inch higher on ACCESS after APIs.

text.p: U.S. spot oil products eked out small gains in after-hours ACCESS trade on Tuesday following new API data showing a 3.1 million barrel draw on gasoline stocks and a million-barrel build in distillates for the prior week.

Although bearish on the surface, the distillate data showed a somewhat-bullish 748,000-barrel drop in heating oil stocks in the key East Coast market, where supplies remain 25 percent below those during the same period last year.
January heating oil futures gained about 0.30 cent in ACCESS trade on the news, only partially ofsetting a 1.28-cent drop in earlier NYMEX futures trade.
The API data, for the week ending Dec 13, helped push January gasoline futures about 0.20 cent higher in ACCESS trade, adding to an earlier 0.25-cent NYMEX gain.

But one Gulf Coast trader said the market was more preoccupied with forecasts of colder weather across the Midwest and East Coast and news of a downed catalytic cracker at Exxon's refinery in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.
Gasoline diffs and NYMEX futures prices firmed early in the day on news Exxon shut the 102,000 barrels per day unit for a few days to repair a regenerated catalyst feed line.
